fusions.name: Wrapped and Finished
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank, dealing 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage, and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Lines
fusions.desc: Shoots 3 silk lines at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Tripwire Anchor
fusions.desc: Strings a tripline onto the nearest enemy. It waits 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles is caught in a blast that deals 12 damage.

fusions.name: Plated Spinner
fusions.desc: A bonded spider fights beside you, and each strike deals 4 damage. Anything it hits moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
